description: Params that are shown in diffs and compare but cannot be manually edited. These are managed automatically by the app or are system-critical. Edit this file to add or remove entries — no TypeScript changes needed.

params.name: SCR_ENABLE
params.reason: Managed automatically by the app — must always be 1 for versioning to work

params.name: SCR_USER1
params.reason: Drone serial identity, written only during registration

params.name: SCR_USER2
params.reason: Catalog version marker, written only during flash/update

params.name: FORMAT_VERSION
params.reason: ArduPilot internal EEPROM format version, set by firmware

params.name: SYSID_THISMAV
params.reason: MAVLink system ID — changing this breaks communication
